devdoc.details: Implements only `setDelegate(address)` — the single endpoint method         invoked from `OAppCore`'s constructor. Cross-chain send/receive,         quoting, and config flows are intentionally absent and will not         work. Delete this contract and its deployment when previewnet is         decommissioned.

userdoc.notice: Stand-in for `ILayerZeroEndpointV2` so OFT-based contracts can be         deployed on the ephemeral tezosXPreviewnet chain, which has no real         LayerZero infrastructure.
